decisionLog.decision: Keep bounded autonomy opt-in and use host-native continuation only as transport
decisionLog.why: Preserves WIP=1 and all human, review, test, deploy, and external-write gates

decisionLog.decision: Use exact-candidate proof-carrying adjudication as the default completion authority
decisionLog.why: Separates maker, machine oracle and fresh semantic checker while keeping cost proportional to risk and preserving an explicit honest-host trust boundary

decisionLog.decision: Keep PR #177 within frozen hierarchical review bounds by serializing live evidence and evidence-earned harness controls into a parked follow-up
decisionLog.why: Preserves WIP=1, exact reconstruction, secret scrub and the 1.2 MB / 15-unit fail-closed limits without truncation or a generic binary exception

decisionLog.decision: Reject the blocked 8d4748c candidate and fix every high-confidence checker finding before requesting another exact-candidate review
decisionLog.why: Preserves fail-closed acceptance while adding immediate callback failure propagation, reservation-bound output caps, an OS-owned curl path, argv option-path binding, effective Compose duplicate rejection, and exact split-segment evidence

decisionLog.decision: Batch every reproducible second-checker finding before spending on another full Terra review
decisionLog.why: The ba490 tree review stopped fail closed on an invalid finding location, while local reproduction still proved bounded-output, worker-retry, delivery-conflict, and documentation defects that must be fixed on a new exact tree

decisionLog.decision: Fix four reproduced 48aae checker warnings and reject two refuted warnings without weakening hierarchical or frozen-policy bindings
decisionLog.why: Positional interpreter isolation, callback serialization, loader-path safety and fresh machine evidence are real trust boundaries; the compact-plan schema and closed const policy already satisfy their stated invariants

decisionLog.decision: Fix four reproduced 4bf18 findings and preserve six independently refuted invariants
decisionLog.why: Workflow isolation, organization ownership, mounted secret naming and HEAD-bound verifier bytes were real; compact-plan, mixed-transparent, hierarchical evidence, publication identity and preflight-only findings contradicted the staged implementation

decisionLog.decision: Fix six reproduced 887a5 findings and preserve four independently refuted frozen bindings
decisionLog.why: Strict direct-script parsing, deploy reproducibility, absolute operator storage, PyPy isolation, untracked operand rejection and bounded child capture were real; compact-plan, mixed-transparent, serialized plan-hash and closed-policy warnings repeated claims contradicted by tests

decisionLog.decision: Batch every reproducible latest-checker trust defect before another paid exact review
decisionLog.why: Exact artifacts, receipts, callbacks, readiness, policy digests and immutable successful Checks require fail-closed evidence; officially supported API and previously refuted compact-plan/hierarchical bindings remain unchanged

decisionLog.decision: Fix the two reproducible 0c8dfeb checker defects and preserve six independently verified bindings
decisionLog.why: Absolute attacker-controlled interpreter launch and partial hierarchical provider evidence were reproducible; official GitHub API support plus pre-push, compact-plan, unit-path, plan-hash and prompt/evidence checks contradict the other findings

decisionLog.decision: Use a free isolated fresh different-model/session reviewer as the primary GPG-001 transport and retain paid API only as an explicitly authorized fallback
decisionLog.why: Independent context, exact-candidate binding and App-side revalidation provide the required review property without making every pre-PR review a paid provider call

decisionLog.decision: Stop GPG-001 implementation and restore MEM-8 before any further commit, push, or Draft PR update
decisionLog.why: A fresh full-diff review and independent refute confirmed that commit 954a3b6 deleted the enforceable prompt-bearing tool trust registry, validator, adoption inventory, audit check and mutation sensor without replacement

decisionLog.decision: Complete GPG-001 under the portable local-submission/local-review profile and keep App-backed PROTECTED as an optional upgrade
decisionLog.why: The required independent exact-candidate review, guarded PR flow, owner-controlled merge/deploy, release and dual-host installation are proven without granting the reviewer merge/deploy authority or requiring administration on external repositories
